title: Closing Day of a Returned Home Oxygen Therapy Record
content:
# Closing Day of a Returned Record — Home Oxygen Therapy

The Home Oxygen Therapy record closes on the day the return is confirmed, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

## Elements

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event | the patient or the patient's representative confirms the return |
| Closing day | the day of that confirmation |
| Format | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The patient's daughter, acting as representative, confirms the return of the oxygen equipment on 12 August 2025.

1. The day the return is confirmed is 12 August 2025.
2. The record closes on 2025-08-12.

## Questions answered

**Is the closing day the day the equipment is picked up?** The closing day is the day the return is confirmed.

**How is it written?** As YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-08-12.
